svg.title: Minimal risk condition
svg.desc: Two panels. Left: the robotaxi has pulled over to the kerb, Autoware's own minimal risk manoeuvre. Right: the robotaxi is stopped in its lane with its hazard lights flashing, the rated minimal risk condition of safety goal SG-07. Below, the safe state as WP-C-03 states it: Vehicle stopped and held in its lane with hazard lights on; Autoware pulls over to the kerb first when it still can, but the rated condition is the stop in lane (DQ-016 A)

g.text: Autoware pulls over when it still can
Its own minimal risk manoeuvre, rated QM
If not: stopped and held in its lane
The rated condition: SG-07, ASIL D (DQ-016 A)
When it can no longer drive on safely
No driver takes over: the vehicle reaches a minimal risk condition by itself.
Vehicle stopped and held in its lane with hazard lights on; Autoware pulls over to the kerb first when it still can, but
the rated condition is the stop in lane (DQ-016 A)
